faqIntro.label: FAQ
faqIntro.title: Frequently asked questions
faqIntro.description: Answers to common questions about financing, inventory, delivery, and support.

faqs.question: Do you offer financing or installment payments?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work with financing partners and flexible payment structures depending on the vehicle and buyer profile.

faqs.question: Are all vehicles brand new with warranty?
faqs.answer: Our listed inventory is brand new and backed by the relevant vehicle documentation and warranty details.

faqs.question: Do you offer fleet or bulk discounts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Businesses buying multiple units can request custom fleet pricing and support packages.

faqs.question: Can you deliver vehicles outside Addis Ababa?
faqs.answer: Yes. Delivery can be arranged based on destination and vehicle availability.

story.label: Our Story
story.title: From a focused showroom to a trusted dealership
story.description: We started with a practical mission: connect riders and operators with quality vehicles, clear pricing, and dependable after-sales help.
paragraphs: FatumaMotors grew by staying close to what buyers actually need: durable vehicles, honest advice, and quick follow-up.
Today we serve individual riders, delivery teams, and transport operators with vehicles and support designed for daily use.

mission.label: Our Mission
mission.title: Empowering mobility and enabling livelihoods
mission.description: We believe practical transport creates opportunity. Our role is to make that transport more accessible, dependable, and easier to manage.
